# Overlay for the Kind install's postgres scenario, layered on top of test-values.yaml or
# test-gateway-values.yaml by scripts/setup.sh.
# The database is an external PostgreSQL deployed by setup.sh (scripts/postgres.yaml); the
# connection string is provided through globalSettings__postgreSql__connectionString in custom-secret.
general:
  databaseProvider: "postgres"

database:
  # Don't deploy the bundled MSSQL pod.
  enabled: false

name: CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    # Only charts trigger a release; the bump commit also lives under charts/, so it still
    # re-triggers and resolves to skip (see detect). Non-chart pushes never enter CD.
    paths:
      - charts/**

permissions: {}

# Serialize runs so concurrent merges set the version against the latest main
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  detect:
    name: Detect release
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: write # cancel this run on a version:skip no-op
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      charts: ${{ steps.check.outputs.charts || '[]' }}
      bump_type: ${{ steps.bump.outputs.type }}
    steps:
      - name: Resolve PR and bump type
        id: bump
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/commits/$SHA/pulls" --jq '.[0].number // empty')
          if [[ -z "$PR_NUMBER" ]]; then
            echo "No PR associated with $SHA (e.g. the version-bump commit); skipping"
            exit 0
          fi
          BUMP_TYPE=$(gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json labels \
            --jq '[.labels[].name | select(startswith("version:"))][0] // empty' | sed 's/^version://')
          if [[ -z "$BUMP_TYPE" ]]; then
            echo "::error::PR #$PR_NUMBER has no version:* label"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "pr=$PR_NUMBER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "type=$BUMP_TYPE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # A skip (version:skip label) is a normal no-op, not a release. Cancel the run so it
      # reads as "cancelled" rather than a green success that implies a release happened.
      - name: Cancel run when nothing to release
        if: steps.bump.outputs.type == 'skip'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          echo "No release needed — cancelling this run so it isn't marked successful." | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}/cancel"
          # Block until the cancellation lands so the run finalizes as "cancelled". If it never
          # takes effect, fail rather than silently reporting success.
          for _ in $(seq 1 60); do sleep 5; done
          echo "::error::Cancellation did not take effect within 5 minutes."
          exit 1

      - name: Detect charts
        id: detect
        if: steps.bump.outputs.type != '' && steps.bump.outputs.type != 'skip'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.bump.outputs.pr }}
        run: |
          CHARTS=$(gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json files \
            --jq '[.files[].path | select(startswith("charts/")) | split("/")[1]] | map(select(. == "self-host" or . == "sm-operator")) | unique')
          echo "Detected charts: $CHARTS"
          echo "charts=$CHARTS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Check for chart changes
        id: check
        if: steps.bump.outputs.type != '' && steps.bump.outputs.type != 'skip'
        env:
          CHARTS: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.charts }}
          BUMP_TYPE: ${{ steps.bump.outputs.type }}
        run: |
          # Safety net: the charts/** path filter should guarantee a chart changed whenever a
          # real version bump is requested, so this should never fire. Fail loudly rather than
          # feed an empty matrix downstream or silently release nothing.
          if [[ -z "$CHARTS" || "$(jq 'length' <<< "$CHARTS")" -eq 0 ]]; then
            echo "::error::Version bump '$BUMP_TYPE' requested but no self-host/sm-operator chart changes were detected."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "charts=$CHARTS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  version-bump:
    name: Version bump (${{ matrix.chart }})
    needs: detect
    if: needs.detect.outputs.bump_type != '' && needs.detect.outputs.bump_type != 'skip'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_version-bump.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    strategy:
      max-parallel: 1 # one commit to main at a time when a PR touches both charts
      matrix:
        chart: ${{ fromJSON(needs.detect.outputs.charts) }}
    with:
      chart: ${{ matrix.chart }}
      bump_type: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.bump_type }}
    secrets: inherit

  # The deploy-side release-helm-charts publishes whatever the latest successful build
  # uploaded, so release must wait until the build that packaged the bumped version has
  # succeeded on main. One job per bumped chart waits independently for its build whose
  # Chart.yaml version at the run's head commit matches the version now on main, rather than
  # trusting a specific SHA (the bump may land as a squash or merge commit).
  wait-for-build:
    name: Wait for build (${{ matrix.chart }})
    needs:
      - detect
      - version-bump
    if: needs.detect.outputs.bump_type != '' && needs.detect.outputs.bump_type != 'skip'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # KIND e2e in the build workflows is slow; give the wait plenty of headroom.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      actions: read # read build-workflow run status
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        chart: ${{ fromJSON(needs.detect.outputs.charts) }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out main
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: main # the version bump has already landed here
          fetch-depth: 0 # need each build run's head commit to read its Chart.yaml version
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Wait for chart build
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          CHART: ${{ matrix.chart }}
        run: |
          case "$CHART" in
            self-host)   workflow="self-host.yml" ;;
            sm-operator) workflow="sm-operator.yml" ;;
            *) echo "::error::Unknown chart '$CHART'"; exit 1 ;;
          esac

          expected=$(yq -r '.version' "charts/${CHART}/Chart.yaml")
          echo "Locating '$workflow' build packaging $CHART $expected on main..."

          # Find the run for the bumped version (not a stale pre-bump build), waiting for the
          # bump commit's push to spawn it, then let gh run watch block until it succeeds.
          run_id=""
          deadline=$(( SECONDS + 15 * 60 ))
          while (( SECONDS < deadline )); do
            while read -r id sha; do
              [[ -z "$id" ]] && continue
              version=$(git show "${sha}:charts/${CHART}/Chart.yaml" 2>/dev/null | yq -r '.version' 2>/dev/null || echo "")
              if [[ "$version" == "$expected" ]]; then run_id="$id"; break; fi
            done < <(gh run list --workflow "$workflow" --branch main --event push --limit 20 \
              --json databaseId,headSha --jq '.[] | "\(.databaseId) \(.headSha)"')
            [[ -n "$run_id" ]] && break
            echo "  build run not found yet; retrying in 20s"
            sleep 20
          done

          if [[ -z "$run_id" ]]; then
            echo "::error::No '$workflow' build run found for $CHART $expected"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Watching build run $run_id for $CHART $expected..."
          gh run watch "$run_id" --exit-status --interval 30

  release:
    name: Release charts
    needs: wait-for-build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      id-token: write # Azure OIDC for the trigger-actions composite
    steps:
      - name: Trigger release in deploy
        uses: bitwarden/gh-actions/trigger-actions@main
        with:
          azure_subscription_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
          azure_tenant_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          azure_client_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          task: release-helm-charts

name: _test

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      chart_name:
        description: 'Name of the chart to test'
        required: true
        type: string
        
permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  _CHART_PATH: charts/${{ inputs.chart_name }}

jobs:
  kubernetes-api-validation:
    name: Kubernetes API validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Helm
        uses: Azure/setup-helm@9bc31f4ebc9c6b171d7bfbaa5d006ae7abdb4310 # v5.0.1

      - name: Install Kubepug
        run: |
          KUBEPUG_VERSION=$(curl -L --silent --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' "https://api.github.com/repos/rikatz/kubepug/releases/latest" | jq -r .tag_name)
          wget -q --https-only --max-redirect=2 "https://github.com/rikatz/kubepug/releases/download/$KUBEPUG_VERSION/kubepug_linux_amd64.tar.gz"

          # Extract and setup binary in path
          tar -xf kubepug_linux_amd64.tar.gz
          mv kubepug /usr/local/bin
          chmod +x /usr/local/bin/kubepug

      - name: Kubepug test
        run: |
          # Get last three stable versions
          VERSIONS=$(curl -L --silent --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' "https://api.github.com/repos/kubernetes/kubernetes/releases" | jq -r '[.[] | select(.prerelease == false) | .tag_name] | .[0:3] | @json')

          # Test each chart with the last three stable versions, across all CI values files
          echo "$VERSIONS" | jq -r '.[]' | while read -r version; do
            for values_file in "${_CHART_PATH}"/ci/*.yaml; do
              echo "Testing chart: ${_CHART_PATH} with values: ${values_file} on Kubernetes version: $version"
              helm template "${_CHART_PATH}" --values "${values_file}" --api-versions "$version" \
                | kubepug --error-on-deprecated --error-on-deleted --k8s-version "$version" --input-file /dev/stdin
            done
          done

  helm-unit-test:
    name: Unit tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Helm
        uses: Azure/setup-helm@9bc31f4ebc9c6b171d7bfbaa5d006ae7abdb4310 # v5.0.1
        with:
          version: 'v4.0.0'
      
      - name: Install Helm plugins
        run: helm plugin install https://github.com/helm-unittest/helm-unittest.git --verify=false

      - name: Run Helm unit tests
        run: helm unittest "${_CHART_PATH}" --output-type JUnit --output-file test-results.xml

      - name: Report test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@d1b5dff021aa968b288b02285a8bf47471c5928a # v3.2.0
        if: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: Test Results
          path: "**/test-results.xml"
          reporter: java-junit
          fail-on-error: true

suite: test post-install db migrator job
templates:
  - templates/helpers.tpl
  - templates/post-install-db-migrator-job.yaml
tests:
  - it: should include vault.mdf check and mssql-data volume when database enabled and no accessMode override
    template: templates/post-install-db-migrator-job.yaml
    set:
      database.enabled: true
    asserts:
      - isKind:
          of: Job
      - matchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "vault\\.mdf"
      - matchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "SQL Ready"
      - matchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "Admin Ready"
      - matchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "DB Ready"
      - matchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "grep -q false"
      - notMatchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "!= .true."
      - contains:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].volumeMounts
          content:
            name: mssql-data
            mountPath: /db
      - contains:
          path: spec.template.spec.volumes
          content:
            name: mssql-data
            persistentVolumeClaim:
              claimName: RELEASE-NAME-self-host-mssqldata

  - it: should skip vault.mdf check and mssql-data volume when accessMode is set on data volume
    template: templates/post-install-db-migrator-job.yaml
    set:
      database.enabled: true
      database.volume.data.accessMode: ReadWriteOnce
    asserts:
      - isKind:
          of: Job
      - matchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "SQL Ready"
      - matchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "Admin Ready"
      - notMatchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "vault\\.mdf"
      - notMatchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "DB Ready"
      - isEmpty:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].volumeMounts
      - notContains:
          path: spec.template.spec.volumes
          content:
            name: mssql-data
          any: true

  - it: should skip SQL and vault.mdf checks when database is disabled
    template: templates/post-install-db-migrator-job.yaml
    set:
      database.enabled: false
    asserts:
      - isKind:
          of: Job
      - matchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "Admin Ready"
      - matchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "grep -q false"
      - notMatchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "!= .true."
      - notMatchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "SQL Ready"
      - notMatchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "vault\\.mdf"
      - isEmpty:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].volumeMounts
      - notContains:
          path: spec.template.spec.volumes
          content:
            name: mssql-data
          any: true

  - it: should not render job when databaseProvider is postgres
    template: templates/post-install-db-migrator-job.yaml
    set:
      general.databaseProvider: postgres
    asserts:
      - hasDocuments:
          count: 0

  - it: should append the timeout to the transition args when migrationTimeoutSeconds is set
    template: templates/post-install-db-migrator-job.yaml
    set:
      database.enabled: false
      jobs.db.migrationTimeoutSeconds: "900"
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].args
          value: ["-f", "DbScripts_transition", "-r", "-t", "900"]

  - it: should pass only the timeout when transition args are not rendered
    template: templates/post-install-db-migrator-job.yaml
    set:
      database.enabled: true
      jobs.db.migrationTimeoutSeconds: "900"
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].args
          value: ["-t", "900"]

  - it: should not set args when database is enabled and no timeout is set
    template: templates/post-install-db-migrator-job.yaml
    set:
      database.enabled: true
    asserts:
      - isNull:
          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].args

suite: pre-install-job password generation
templates:
  - templates/helpers.tpl
  - templates/pre-install-job.yaml

# These tests lock in the fix for the three Go-template scoping bugs that
# previously caused $identityCertPasswordTxtValue to render as the literal
# string "map[]" instead of a random 32-character password.
#
# helm-unittest cannot stub the `lookup` function, so the existing-secret
# reuse branch is not directly testable here; rendered-output regex on the
# generate path is what catches a regression that re-introduces "map[]".

tests:
  - it: renders a 32-char alphanumeric password into the openssl initContainer
    template: templates/pre-install-job.yaml
    set:
      secrets.identityCertificate.generate: true
    asserts:
      - matchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "pass:[A-Za-z0-9]{32};"
      - notMatchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "pass:map\\[\\]"

  - it: renders a 32-char alphanumeric password into the kubectl secret-create command
    template: templates/pre-install-job.yaml
    set:
      secrets.identityCertificate.generate: true
    asserts:
      - matchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].args[0]
          pattern: 'globalSettings__identityServer__certificatePassword="[A-Za-z0-9]{32}"'
      - notMatchRegex:
          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].args[0]
          pattern: "certificatePassword=.{0,4}map\\[\\]"

  - it: renders nothing when secrets.identityCertificate.generate is false
    template: templates/pre-install-job.yaml
    set:
      secrets.identityCertificate.generate: false
    asserts:
      - hasDocuments:
          count: 0

suite: test pre-install db migrator job
templates:
  - templates/helpers.tpl
  - templates/pre-install-db-migrator-job.yaml
tests:
  - it: should pass the timeout when migrationTimeoutSeconds is set
    template: templates/pre-install-db-migrator-job.yaml
    set:
      jobs.db.migrationTimeoutSeconds: "900"
    asserts:
      - isKind:
          of: Job
      - equal:
          path: metadata.annotations["helm.sh/hook"]
          value: pre-upgrade
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].args
          value: ["-t", "900"]

  - it: should pass the timeout when database is disabled
    template: templates/pre-install-db-migrator-job.yaml
    set:
      database.enabled: false
      jobs.db.migrationTimeoutSeconds: "900"
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: metadata.annotations["helm.sh/hook"]
          value: pre-install,pre-upgrade
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].args
          value: ["-t", "900"]

  - it: should pass the timeout when migrationTimeoutSeconds is "0" for unlimited
    template: templates/pre-install-db-migrator-job.yaml
    set:
      jobs.db.migrationTimeoutSeconds: "0"
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].args
          value: ["-t", "0"]

  - it: should not set args when no timeout is set
    template: templates/pre-install-db-migrator-job.yaml
    asserts:
      - isNull:
          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].args

  - it: should not render job when databaseProvider is postgres
    template: templates/pre-install-db-migrator-job.yaml
    set:
      general.databaseProvider: postgres
      jobs.db.migrationTimeoutSeconds: "900"
    asserts:
      - hasDocuments:
          count: 0

  - templates/admin.yaml
  - templates/api.yaml
  - templates/events.yaml
  - templates/icons.yaml
  - templates/identity.yaml
  - templates/notifications.yaml

      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].name

      - equal:

    template: templates/api.yaml

    template: templates/icons.yaml

      component.icons.securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].securityContext.runAsNonRoot
          value: true
        documentIndex: 0

  # identity

    template: templates/identity.yaml
    set:
      volume.logs.enabled: true
      component.identity.securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].securityContext.runAsNonRoot
          value: true
        documentIndex: 0

  # notifications
  - it: notifications - should render securityContext on the create-mount-subdir init container
    template: templates/notifications.yaml
    set:
      volume.logs.enabled: true
      component.notifications.securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].securityContext.runAsNonRoot
          value: true
        documentIndex: 0

  # scim
  - it: scim - should render securityContext on the create-mount-subdir init container
    template: templates/scim.yaml
    set:
      component.scim.enabled: true
      volume.logs.enabled: true
      component.scim.securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].securityContext.runAsNonRoot
          value: true
        documentIndex: 0

  # sso
  - it: sso - should render securityContext on the create-mount-subdir init container
    template: templates/sso.yaml
    set:
      volume.logs.enabled: true
      component.sso.securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.initContainers[0].securityContext.runAsNonRoot
          value: true
        documentIndex: 0

  # pre-install-secret-sql job
  - it: secret-sql - should render pod securityContext from jobs.podSecurityContext
    template: templates/pre-install-secret-sql.yaml
    set:
      jobs.podSecurityContext.runAsNonRoot: true
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot
          value: true
        documentIndex: 0

  - it: secret-sql - should render container securityContext from jobs.securityContext
    template: templates/pre-install-secret-sql.yaml
    set:
      jobs.securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation
          value: false
        documentIndex: 0

  - it: secret-sql - should not render securityContext blocks when unset
    template: templates/pre-install-secret-sql.yaml
    asserts:
      - isNull:
          path: spec.template.spec.securityContext
        documentIndex: 0
      - isNull:
          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].securityContext
        documentIndex: 0

# Custom labels to be applied to all resources created by the operator
# These labels are used in CI testing to verify the custom label feature works correctly
commonLabels:
  test-label: test-value

settings:
  # How often the secrets synchronize in seconds.  Minimum value is 180.
  bwSecretsManagerRefreshInterval: 300
  # Cloud region for sync.  Please see: https://bitwarden.com/help/families-for-enterprise-self-hosted/#step-1-enable-cloud-communication
  cloudRegion: US
  # Set only if self-hosted.  These are the URLs for the Bitwarden API and Identity services
  bwApiUrlOverride:
  bwIdentityUrlOverride:
  # This is the internal Kubernetes DNS zone.  You will likely not need to change this
  # unless you have specifically changed the internal DNS name.
  kubernetesClusterDomain: cluster.local

name: Update Versions - SM Operator

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: "Operator version to sync (e.g., 2.0.0). If omitted, the latest sm-kubernetes release is used."
        required: false
        type: string

permissions: {}

jobs:
  update-versions:
    name: Update Versions
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write # Azure OIDC for the trigger-actions composite
    steps:
      - name: Check out repo
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Get Latest Operator Version
        id: get-operator-version
        if: inputs.version == ''
        uses: bitwarden/gh-actions/get-release-version@main
        with:
          repository: bitwarden/sm-kubernetes
          trim: true

      - name: Check if operator needs updating
        id: operator-update
        env:
          LATEST_OPERATOR_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version != '' && inputs.version || steps.get-operator-version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          OPERATOR_VERSION=$(sed -nE 's/^appVersion:\s+([^\s]+)/\1/p' Chart.yaml)

          echo "Operator Version: $OPERATOR_VERSION"
          echo "Latest Operator Version: $LATEST_OPERATOR_VERSION"
          if [ "$OPERATOR_VERSION" != "$LATEST_OPERATOR_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "Needs Operator update!"
            echo "update=1" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "version=$LATEST_OPERATOR_VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "update=0" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
        working-directory: charts/sm-operator

      - name: Update Chart appVersion
        if: ${{ steps.operator-update.outputs.update == '1' }}
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.operator-update.outputs.version }}
        run: 'sed -i -e "s/appVersion:.*/appVersion: ${VERSION}/" Chart.yaml'
        working-directory: charts/sm-operator

      - name: Sync BitwardenSecret CRD from operator release
        if: ${{ steps.operator-update.outputs.update == '1' }}
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.operator-update.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SOURCE_URL="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bitwarden/sm-kubernetes/v${VERSION}/config/crd/bases/k8s.bitwarden.com_bitwardensecrets.yaml"
          TARGET="charts/sm-operator/templates/bitwardensecret-crd.yaml"
          PLACEHOLDER="__SM_OPERATOR_HELM_LABELS__"

          curl -fsSL -o /tmp/sm-operator-crd.yaml "$SOURCE_URL"

          {
            echo "# This file is synced from bitwarden/sm-kubernetes by the Update Versions - SM Operator workflow."
            echo "# Do not edit manually. To resync, run the workflow against a new operator release tag."
            yq -I 2 ".metadata.labels = \"$PLACEHOLDER\"" /tmp/sm-operator-crd.yaml \
              | sed "s#  labels: $PLACEHOLDER#  labels:\n  {{- include \"sm-operator.labels\" . | nindent 4 }}#"
          } > "$TARGET"

      - name: Set up Helm
        if: ${{ steps.operator-update.outputs.update == '1' }}
        uses: Azure/setup-helm@9bc31f4ebc9c6b171d7bfbaa5d006ae7abdb4310 # v5.0.1

      - name: Validate synced CRD renders
        if: ${{ steps.operator-update.outputs.update == '1' }}
        run: helm template charts/sm-operator --show-only templates/bitwardensecret-crd.yaml

      - name: Upload modified files
        id: upload
        if: ${{ steps.operator-update.outputs.update == '1' }}
        uses: bitwarden/gh-actions/upload-modified-files@main
        with:
          artifact_name: modified-files

      # Build the trigger payload with jq so the fetched version is JSON-escaped, not
      # interpolated into the data string (no break-out / key injection).
      - name: Build trigger data
        id: data
        if: ${{ steps.operator-update.outputs.update == '1' }}
        env:
          ARTIFACT_NAME: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.artifact_name }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.operator-update.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          JSON=$(jq -nc \
            --arg artifact_name "$ARTIFACT_NAME" \
            --arg target_branch "main" \
            --arg pr_title "Update operator version to $VERSION" \
            --arg pr_body "Automated update to appVersion in charts/sm-operator/Chart.yaml and synced BitwardenSecret CRD" \
            --arg pr_labels "version:patch" \
            '{artifact_name: $artifact_name, target_branch: $target_branch, pr_title: $pr_title, pr_body: $pr_body, pr_labels: $pr_labels}')
          echo "json=$JSON" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Trigger update
        if: ${{ steps.operator-update.outputs.update == '1' }}
        uses: bitwarden/gh-actions/trigger-actions@main
        with:
          azure_subscription_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
          azure_tenant_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          azure_client_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          task: update-repository
          data: ${{ steps.data.outputs.json }}

name: Update Versions - Self Host

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

jobs:
  update-versions:
    name: Update Versions
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out repo
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Get latest core version
        id: get-core
        uses: bitwarden/gh-actions/get-release-version@main
        with:
          repository: bitwarden/server
          trim: true

      - name: Get latest web version
        id: get-web
        uses: bitwarden/gh-actions/get-release-version@main
        with:
          repository: bitwarden/clients
          monorepo: true
          monorepo-project: web
          trim: true

      - name: Check if versions need updating
        id: check
        env:
          LATEST_CORE_VERSION: ${{ steps.get-core.outputs.version }}
          LATEST_WEB_VERSION: ${{ steps.get-web.outputs.version }}
        working-directory: charts/self-host/templates
        run: |
          CORE_VERSION=$(sed -r -n '/define "bitwarden.coreVersionDefault"/!b;n;'\
          's/\{\{- "([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)" -\}\}/\1/p' helpers.tpl)
          WEB_VERSION=$(sed -r -n '/define "bitwarden.webVersionDefault"/!b;n;'\
          's/\{\{- "([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)" -\}\}/\1/p' helpers.tpl)

          echo "Core version: $CORE_VERSION -> $LATEST_CORE_VERSION"
          echo "Web version:  $WEB_VERSION -> $LATEST_WEB_VERSION"
          if [[ "$CORE_VERSION" != "$LATEST_CORE_VERSION" || "$WEB_VERSION" != "$LATEST_WEB_VERSION" ]]; then
            echo "update=1" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "update=0" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Versions already current; nothing to do." | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

      - name: Verify image versions are on GHCR
        if: ${{ steps.check.outputs.update == '1' }}
        env:
          COREVERSION: ${{ steps.get-core.outputs.version }}
          WEBVERSION: ${{ steps.get-web.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          echo "Checking..."

          coreimages=( "admin" "api" "attachments" "events" "icons" "identity" "notifications" "scim" "sso" "mssqlmigratorutility" )

          test_image() {
              image=$1
              version=$2
              tag=$(skopeo list-tags "docker://ghcr.io/bitwarden/$image" | jq '.Tags[]' | grep "$version")
              if [[ -z "$tag" ]]; then
                  echo "$image - $version - NOT FOUND!"
                  echo "Stopping..."
                  exit 1
              else
                  echo "$image - $tag - FOUND"
              fi
          }

          echo "Core Images ($COREVERSION)..."
          for image in "${coreimages[@]}"; do
              test_image "$image" "$COREVERSION"
          done

          echo "Web Image ($WEBVERSION)..."
          test_image "web" "$WEBVERSION"

      - name: Update core version
        if: ${{ steps.check.outputs.update == '1' }}
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.get-core.outputs.version }}
        working-directory: charts/self-host/templates
        run: sed -i '/define "bitwarden.coreVersionDefault"/!b;n;c{{- "'"$VERSION"'" -}}' helpers.tpl

      - name: Update web version
        if: ${{ steps.check.outputs.update == '1' }}
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.get-web.outputs.version }}
        working-directory: charts/self-host/templates
        run: sed -i '/define "bitwarden.webVersionDefault"/!b;n;c{{- "'"$VERSION"'" -}}' helpers.tpl

      - name: Update chart appVersion
        if: ${{ steps.check.outputs.update == '1' }}
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.get-core.outputs.version }}
        working-directory: charts/self-host
        run: 'sed -i -e "s/appVersion:.*/appVersion: ${VERSION}/" Chart.yaml'

      - name: Upload modified files
        id: upload
        if: ${{ steps.check.outputs.update == '1' }}
        uses: bitwarden/gh-actions/upload-modified-files@main
        with:
          artifact_name: modified-files

      # version:patch labels the PR so it auto-merges and releases through cd.yml.
      - name: Build trigger data
        id: data
        if: ${{ steps.check.outputs.update == '1' }}
        env:
          ARTIFACT_NAME: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.artifact_name }}
          CORE_VERSION: ${{ steps.get-core.outputs.version }}
          WEB_VERSION: ${{ steps.get-web.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          JSON=$(jq -nc \
            --arg artifact_name "$ARTIFACT_NAME" \
            --arg target_branch "main" \
            --arg pr_title "Update self-host versions: core $CORE_VERSION, web $WEB_VERSION" \
            --arg pr_body "Automated update to core version \`$CORE_VERSION\` and web version \`$WEB_VERSION\`." \
            --arg pr_labels "version:patch" \
            '{artifact_name: $artifact_name, target_branch: $target_branch, pr_title: $pr_title, pr_body: $pr_body, pr_labels: $pr_labels}')
          echo "json=$JSON" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Trigger update
        if: ${{ steps.check.outputs.update == '1' }}
        uses: bitwarden/gh-actions/trigger-actions@main
        with:
          azure_subscription_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
          azure_tenant_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          azure_client_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          task: update-repository
          data: ${{ steps.data.outputs.json }}

    steps:

        with:

        env:

        run: helm plugin install https://github.com/dadav/helm-schema --version "${HELM_SCHEMA_VERSION}" --verify=false # see: https://github.com/dadav/helm-schema/issues/156

      - name: Set up chart-testing
        uses: helm/chart-testing-action@720270857a28afd41e2426521a7801db09e9b510 # v2.9.0

name: _version-bump

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      chart:
        description: "Chart directory under charts/ to bump (e.g. self-host)."
        required: true
        type: string
      bump_type:
        description: "Semver bump to apply: major, minor, or patch."
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

jobs:
  bump:
    name: Bump ${{ inputs.chart }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out chart
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: main # compute from current main, not the pinned merge commit
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Compute next version
        id: compute
        env:
          CHART: ${{ inputs.chart }}
          BUMP_TYPE: ${{ inputs.bump_type }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          CURRENT=$(yq -r '.version' "charts/${CHART}/Chart.yaml")
          if [[ ! "$CURRENT" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::charts/${CHART}/Chart.yaml version '$CURRENT' must be MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH format"
            exit 1
          fi
          IFS='.' read -r MAJOR MINOR PATCH <<< "$CURRENT"
          case "$BUMP_TYPE" in
            major) NEXT="$((MAJOR + 1)).0.0" ;;
            minor) NEXT="${MAJOR}.$((MINOR + 1)).0" ;;
            patch) NEXT="${MAJOR}.${MINOR}.$((PATCH + 1))" ;;
            *) echo "::error::Invalid bump type: $BUMP_TYPE"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          echo "Chart $CHART: $CURRENT -> $NEXT" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

          # Skip if this chart release already exists (e.g. a re-run).
          if gh release view "${CHART}-${NEXT}" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Release ${CHART}-${NEXT} already exists — skipping." | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else
            echo "version=$NEXT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Validate computed version
        if: steps.compute.outputs.version != ''
        uses: bitwarden/gh-actions/version-check@main
        with:
          version: ${{ steps.compute.outputs.version }}
          validation_type: semver

      - name: Bump chart version
        if: steps.compute.outputs.version != ''
        uses: bitwarden/gh-actions/version-bump@main
        with:
          file_path: "charts/${{ inputs.chart }}/Chart.yaml"
          version: ${{ steps.compute.outputs.version }}

      - name: Upload modified files
        id: upload
        if: steps.compute.outputs.version != ''
        uses: bitwarden/gh-actions/upload-modified-files@main
        with:
          artifact_name: modified-files-${{ inputs.chart }}

      - name: Build trigger data
        id: data
        if: steps.compute.outputs.version != ''
        env:
          ARTIFACT_NAME: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.artifact_name }}
          CHART: ${{ inputs.chart }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.compute.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          JSON=$(jq -nc \
            --arg artifact_name "$ARTIFACT_NAME" \
            --arg target_branch "main" \
            --arg pr_title "Bump $CHART chart version to $VERSION" \
            --arg pr_body "Automated version bump to $VERSION" \
            --arg pr_labels "version:skip" \
            '{artifact_name: $artifact_name, target_branch: $target_branch, pr_title: $pr_title, pr_body: $pr_body, pr_labels: $pr_labels}')
          echo "json=$JSON" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # version:skip lets the bump PR pass enforce-labels; its merge resolves to skip in cd.yml.
      - name: Land the bump on main
        if: steps.compute.outputs.version != ''
        uses: bitwarden/gh-actions/trigger-actions@main
        with:
          azure_subscription_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
          azure_tenant_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          azure_client_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          task: update-repository
          data: ${{ steps.data.outputs.json }}

    name: Test self-host chart
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_test_chart.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    with:
      chart_name: self-host
  
  test-self-host-kind:
    name: Test self-host chart with Kind (${{ matrix.name }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # Postgres and BYOS don't depend on routing, so each runs once instead of on every routing.
        # Give a new entry all four keys: a missing one falls back to the setup.sh default.
        include:
          - name: ingress
            routing: ingress
            database: mssql
            secrets: generate
          - name: gateway
            routing: gateway
            database: mssql
            secrets: generate
          - name: ingress, postgres
            routing: ingress
            database: postgres
            secrets: generate
          - name: gateway, postgres, restricted pod security
            routing: gateway
            database: postgres
            secrets: generate
            podSecurity: restricted
          - name: gateway, byos
            routing: gateway
            database: mssql
            secrets: byos
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Helm
        uses: Azure/setup-helm@9bc31f4ebc9c6b171d7bfbaa5d006ae7abdb4310 # v5.0.1
        with:
          version: v4.2.0

      - name: Set up lynx
        run: sudo apt install lynx

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.15"
          check-latest: true

      - name: Create kind cluster
        uses: helm/kind-action@1544676c07bb3570fcb70166beaa07c4528fd4aa # v1.15.1
        with:
          config: ${{ matrix.routing == 'gateway' && 'scripts/cluster-gateway.yaml' || 'scripts/cluster.yaml' }}

      - name: Set up cluster
        run: ./scripts/setup.sh setup-cluster "${{ matrix.routing }}" "${{ matrix.database }}" "${{ matrix.secrets }}" "${{ matrix.podSecurity }}"

      - name: Install self-host (${{ matrix.routing }}, ${{ matrix.database }}, ${{ matrix.secrets }})
        run: |
          # Helm deletes the migrator pods when the hook fails, so save their logs and pod details as the install runs.
          mkdir -p /tmp/migrator-logs
          (while true; do
            for pod in $(kubectl get pods -n bitwarden -l app.kubernetes.io/component=post-install-db-migrator-job -o name 2>/dev/null); do
              name="/tmp/migrator-logs/${pod#pod/}"
              kubectl logs "$pod" -n bitwarden --all-containers > "$name.tmp" 2>&1 && mv "$name.tmp" "$name.log" || true
              kubectl describe "$pod" -n bitwarden > "$name.tmp" 2>&1 && mv "$name.tmp" "$name-describe.log" || true
            done
            sleep 5
          done) &
          trap 'kill $!' EXIT
          ./scripts/setup.sh install-self-host "${{ matrix.routing }}" "${{ matrix.database }}" "${{ matrix.secrets }}" "${{ matrix.podSecurity }}"

      - name: Diagnostics
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if compgen -G "/tmp/migrator-logs/*.log" > /dev/null; then
            echo "*****MIGRATOR LOGS*****"
            tail -n +1 /tmp/migrator-logs/*.log
          fi

          echo "*****DEPLOYMENTS*****"; kubectl get deployments -n bitwarden || true
          echo "*****PODS*****";        kubectl get pods -n bitwarden -o wide || true
          echo "*****SERVICES*****";    kubectl get svc -n bitwarden || true
          echo "*****JOBS*****";        kubectl get jobs -n bitwarden || true

          echo "*****EVENTS*****"
          kubectl get events -n bitwarden --sort-by=.lastTimestamp || true

          echo "*****DESCRIBE PODS*****"
          kubectl describe pods -n bitwarden || true

          echo "*****DESCRIBE JOBS*****"
          kubectl describe jobs -n bitwarden || true

          echo "*****POD LOGS*****"
          for pod in $(kubectl get pods -n bitwarden -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'); do
            echo "----- logs: $pod (current) -----"
            kubectl logs "$pod" -n bitwarden --all-containers --tail=200 || true
            echo "----- logs: $pod (previous, if crashed) -----"
            kubectl logs "$pod" -n bitwarden --all-containers --previous --tail=200 || true
          done

          if [ "${{ matrix.routing }}" = "gateway" ]; then
            echo "*****GATEWAY*****";   kubectl describe gateway -n default ci-gateway || true
            echo "*****HTTPROUTE*****"; kubectl describe httproute -n bitwarden || true
          else
            echo "*****INGRESS*****";   kubectl describe ingress -n bitwarden || true
          fi

          if [ "${{ matrix.podSecurity }}" = "restricted" ]; then
            echo "*****POSTGRES*****"
            kubectl get pods -n database -o wide || true
            kubectl describe pods -n database || true
            kubectl logs deploy/postgres -n database --tail=200 || true
          fi

      - name: Smoke tests
        run: ./scripts/smoke-test.sh

      - name: Verify Postgres migrations
        if: matrix.database == 'postgres'
        run: ./scripts/setup.sh verify-postgres "${{ matrix.routing }}" "${{ matrix.database }}" "${{ matrix.secrets }}" "${{ matrix.podSecurity }}"

  build-self-host:
    name: Build self-host chart
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_build.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    with:
      chart_name: self-host
    needs:
      - lint-self-host
      - test-self-host
      - test-self-host-kind
    secrets:
      AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
      AZURE_TENANT_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
      AZURE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}

name: _build

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      chart_name:
        type: string
        required: true
    secrets:
      AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID:
        required: true
      AZURE_TENANT_ID:
        required: true
      AZURE_CLIENT_ID:
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

env:
  _CHART_NAME: ${{ inputs.chart_name }}

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build Helm charts
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true

      - name: Set up Helm
        uses: Azure/setup-helm@9bc31f4ebc9c6b171d7bfbaa5d006ae7abdb4310 # v5.0.1
        with:
          version: 'v4.0.0'

      - name: Log in to Azure
        uses: bitwarden/gh-actions/azure-login@main
        with:
          subscription_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
          tenant_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          client_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}

      - name: Set up GPG key and passphrase
        run: |
          az keyvault secret download \
            --vault-name bitwarden-ci \
            --name helm-signing-gpg-private-key \
            --file private

          az keyvault secret download \
          --vault-name bitwarden-ci \
          --name helm-signing-gpg-private-key-passphrase \
          --file .passphrase

          az keyvault secret download \
          --vault-name bitwarden-ci \
          --name helm-signing-gpg-public-key \
          --file public

          gpg --dearmor private
          gpg --dearmor public

      - name: Log out from Azure
        uses: bitwarden/gh-actions/azure-logout@main

      - name: Generate release notes
        id: release_notes
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          # Get the last release tag
          last_tag=$(gh release list --exclude-pre-releases --exclude-drafts --json "tagName" --limit 100 | jq -r --arg prefix "$_CHART_NAME" '.[] | select(.tagName | startswith($prefix)) | .tagName' | head -1)

          if [ -z "$last_tag" ]; then
            echo "No previous release tag found, generating notes from initial commit"
            commit_range="$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD)..HEAD"
          else
            echo "Generating release notes since tag: $last_tag"
            commit_range="${last_tag}..HEAD"
          fi

          changelog_file="charts/${_CHART_NAME}/CHANGELOG.md"
          chart_description=$(helm show chart "charts/${_CHART_NAME}" | yq -e '.description')
          chart_version=$(helm show chart "charts/${_CHART_NAME}" | yq -e '.version')

          # Initialize arrays for tracking
          declare -A prs_found
          declare -A contributors
          declare -A new_contributors
          whats_changed=""

          # Get all commits for this chart
          while IFS= read -r commit_hash; do
            commit_msg=$(git log -1 --pretty=format:"%s" "$commit_hash")
            commit_author=$(git log -1 --pretty=format:"%an" "$commit_hash")
            commit_email=$(git log -1 --pretty=format:"%ae" "$commit_hash")

            # Try to extract PR number from commit message (e.g., "message (#123)" or "Merge pull request #123")
            pr_num=""
            if [[ $commit_msg =~ \(#([0-9]+)\) ]]; then
              pr_num="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            elif [[ $commit_msg =~ Merge\ pull\ request\ #([0-9]+) ]]; then
              pr_num="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            elif [[ $commit_msg =~ \#([0-9]+) ]]; then
              pr_num="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            fi

            # If we found a PR number and haven't processed it yet
            if [[ -n "$pr_num" ]] && [[ -z "${prs_found[$pr_num]}" ]]; then
              prs_found[$pr_num]=1

              # Try to get PR details from GitHub API
              if pr_data=$(gh pr view "$pr_num" --json title,author,number,url 2>/dev/null); then
                pr_title=$(echo "$pr_data" | jq -r '.title')
                pr_author=$(echo "$pr_data" | jq -r '.author.login')
                pr_url=$(echo "$pr_data" | jq -r '.url')

                # Add to what's changed
                whats_changed+="- ${pr_title} by [@${pr_author}](https://github.com/${pr_author}) in [#${pr_num}](${pr_url})"$'\n'

                # Track contributor
                contributors[$pr_author]=1

                # Check if this is a new contributor (first PR)
                pr_count=$(gh pr list --author "$pr_author" --state merged --limit 100 --json number | jq '. | length')
                if [[ "$pr_count" -eq 1 ]]; then
                  new_contributors[$pr_author]="[#${pr_num}](${pr_url})"
                fi
              else
                # Fallback if API call fails - use commit info
                whats_changed+="- ${commit_msg} (${commit_hash:0:7})"$'\n'
              fi
            elif [[ -z "$pr_num" ]]; then
              # No PR found, add commit directly
              whats_changed+="- ${commit_msg} (${commit_hash:0:7})"$'\n'
            fi
          done < <(git log "$commit_range" --pretty=format:"%H" --reverse -- "charts/${_CHART_NAME}")

          # Build the changelog content
          {
            echo "$chart_description"
            echo ""
            echo "## What's Changed"
            if [[ -n "$whats_changed" ]]; then
              echo "$whats_changed"
            else
              echo "No changes found for this chart."
            fi

            # Add new contributors section if any
            if [[ ${#new_contributors[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
              echo ""
              echo "## New Contributors"
              for contributor in "${!new_contributors[@]}"; do
                pr_link="${new_contributors[$contributor]}"
                echo "- [@${contributor}](https://github.com/${contributor}) made their first contribution in ${pr_link}"
              done
            fi

            # Add full changelog link
            if [[ -n "$last_tag" ]]; then
              echo ""
              echo "**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/compare/${last_tag}...${_CHART_NAME}-${chart_version}"
            fi
          } > "$changelog_file"

          echo "Release notes generated:"
          cat "$changelog_file"

      - name: Package Helm chart
        id: helm_package
        run: |
          helm package \
            --sign \
            --key "BRE Team" \
            --keyring private.gpg \
            --passphrase-file .passphrase \
            "charts/${_CHART_NAME}"
          PKG_NAME=$(ls ./*.tgz)
          echo "name=$PKG_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Verify Helm chart
        env:
          _HELM_OUTPUT_NAME: ${{ steps.helm_package.outputs.name }}
        run: helm verify "${_HELM_OUTPUT_NAME}" --keyring public.gpg

      - name: Upload Helm chart artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.chart_name }}
          path: |
            ${{ steps.helm_package.outputs.name }}
            ${{ steps.helm_package.outputs.name }}.prov
          if-no-files-found: error
